back: To match or agree with (e.g., 'Her complaints tally with the comments we received').
To share or agree with an idea or opinion.
To be in complete agreement with something.
To be the same as (e.g., 'Your views coincide with mine').
To fit in with or match a general standard or definition.
To think something is right or good.
Opposition to the accepted way of thinking.
Lack of agreement or harmony (suggests arguments).
A disagreement that divides people or groups.
When a larger group breaks up into smaller groups due to disagreement.
A more abstract/formal disagreement (e.g., 'a major division in the party').
Something given up to reach an agreement (e.g., 'make several concessions').
Reaching a formal decision or agreement after a dispute.
To use one's judgement and be sensitive in a situation.
Expression used when people continue to hold different opinions but stop arguing.
